description: This file defines the Customer entity class used in the sales management system. It includes fields for customer details such as email, name, gender, date of birth, and associations with other entities like addresses, reviews, groups, merchant store, and localization.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer in the system, with personal details, associated attributes, reviews, group memberships, and localization info.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the customer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the customer.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Retrieves the customer's date of birth, cloning the internal date object.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the customer's date of birth, cloning the provided date object.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the customer.

methods.name: setEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: getNick
methods.description: Returns the customer's nickname.

methods.name: setNick
methods.description: Sets the customer's nickname.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the customer.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name associated with the customer.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the customer's password.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the customer's password.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Checks if the customer is anonymous.

methods.name: setAnonymous
methods.description: Sets whether the customer is anonymous.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Returns the list of product reviews made by the customer.

methods.name: setReviews
methods.description: Sets the list of product reviews.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates the customer with a merchant store.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the customer.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery address for the customer.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Retrieves the delivery address.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing address for the customer.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Retrieves the billing address.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Assigns groups to the customer.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the groups the customer belongs to.

methods.name: getShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Gets the display setting for customer state list.

methods.name: setShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Sets the display setting for customer state list.

methods.name: getShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Gets the display setting for billing state list.

methods.name: setShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Sets the display setting for billing state list.

methods.name: getShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Gets the display setting for delivery state list.

methods.name: setShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Sets the display setting for delivery state list.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language for the customer.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language for the customer.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the customer attributes.

methods.name: setGender
methods.description: Sets the gender of the customer.

methods.name: getGender
methods.description: Returns the gender of the customer.
